dedupe_keys.name: dataset for iot enabled smart manufacturing for energy and resource optimization simulation in schilab

description: Alex Bazigu at Victoria University publishes a Scilab replication of an IoT-enabled manufacturing-control experiment. The script simulates 1,000 steps and generates temperature, pressure, energy, fire-signal, raw-material and production-efficiency outputs, together with fan, sprinkler and pressure-control decisions. Zenodo lists the Scilab source, individual CSV outputs and a result plot. The March 2025 metadata specify MIT for code and CC BY 4.0 for data and documentation, allowing free reuse. Scilab 2025.0.0 or later is the stated runtime. The provider reports energy reductions from the simulation, but these are not measured savings at a real factory and were not reproduced here. The physical site and duration represented by a time step remain unknown. The package supports reproducible control-policy experiments, not a national industrial-demand series. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
